title.narrative: Supporting a More Effective Administration of Justice in Corruption and Organised Crime Cases in the Western Balkans through Trial Monitoring

description.narrative: This action aims at supporting a more effective administration of justice in organised crime and corruption cases in the Western Balkans through trial monitoring. Specifically, it will review practices in this field, identify systemic issues in the judicial response, provide recommendations and disseminate findings
